title: Financial Services & Banking Governance Rulepack
mandatorySecurityControls: Real-Time Fraud Telemetry & Audit Trail Isolation
Dual-Control Approval (Four-Eyes Principle) for Ledger Mutations

rules.title: Cardholder Data Environment (CDE) Tokenization & Encryption
rules.description: Primary account numbers (PAN) and sensitive authentication data must be tokenized and never stored in plaintext.

rules.title: DORA Digital Operational Resilience & Recovery RTO/RPO Enforcement
rules.description: Financial core transaction systems must meet operational resilience thresholds with RTO < 15 mins and RPO < 60s.

rules.title: Real-Time Fraud Detection Telemetry & Tamper-Evident Audit Logs
rules.description: Monetary transfers and key updates must produce cryptographically chained audit events for instant fraud inspection.

rules.title: Four-Eyes Dual Control for High-Value Financial Operations
rules.description: Transactions exceeding financial threshold limits require approval from at least two authorized system roles.

rules.title: Automated SOC 2 Audit Evidence & Continuous Vulnerability Scans
rules.description: Platform components must generate automated SOC 2 audit evidence logs and pass automated vulnerability checks.
